full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting shows five adults seated and conversing beneath a broad patchwork tree against a flat salmon-pink background. The trunk rises from behind the group near the center, then branches into a canopy made from angular teal, turquoise, ocher, coral, gray, and dark green pieces. Along the lower half, a long turquoise bench or low wall runs behind the people, contrasting with a warm orange floor. The leftmost person wears a bright yellow coat and teal hat, turning toward the second seated figure in a dark green jacket. The central person wears a yellow shirt and sits upright with hands near the lap, while two others to the right wear pale and yellow garments with darker trousers. Their bodies are built from simplified painted shapes and varied skin tones; the faces suggest conversation but do not chase photographic likeness. Small vessels and blocklike objects sit near the lower corners, adding bright accents without creating a detailed room. The tree canopy stretches almost to both upper corners, its irregular colored fragments producing a second, larger social gathering of shapes above the figures. Light is even and graphic, with little cast shadow; depth comes from overlap, the bench line, and the different scales of trunk, people, and foreground objects. Brush texture and tiny scraped marks appear inside the broad color fields, keeping them visibly painted. The salmon ground remains spacious around the group and allows the saturated clothes to stand apart. The overall composition is open, warm, and communal, balancing a horizontal line of seated people with the branching rhythm of the geometric canopy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物画描绘五位成年人坐在一棵宽阔拼布树下交谈，背景是平坦的鲑粉色。树干从人群后方中央附近升起，分枝成由折角青绿、蓝绿、赭、珊瑚、灰和深绿碎片组成的树冠。下半部，一条长青绿椅或矮墙横在人们身后，与暖橙地面相对。最左边的人穿亮黄外套、戴青绿帽，转向第二位穿深绿夹克的坐者。中央人物穿黄衬衫，直坐且双手靠近膝上，右侧另两人穿浅色与黄色衣服，配深裤。他们的身体由简化的绘画色形和不同肤色构成；面部暗示谈话，但不追求摄影式肖像。小容器与方块物件置于下方两角，提供亮色强调，却不构成详细室内。树冠几乎伸到上方两角，不规则彩色碎片在人群上方形成第二个更大的形状聚会。光均匀而图形化，几乎没有投影；纵深来自重叠、椅子横线，以及树干、人和前景物件的尺度差。宽色域内部有笔触肌理与小刮痕，使它们明显是画出来的。鲑色底在人群周围保持宽敞，让饱和衣色彼此分开。整体构图开放、温暖而有群体感，以一排坐姿人物的横线平衡几何树冠的分枝节奏。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a modern flat-color figurative surface with visible brush grain and irregular geometric pattern. Salmon, turquoise, mustard, coral, and dark green form large neighboring areas, arranged for warm-cool balance rather than naturalistic shading. Repeated angular fragments gather into a broad upper rhythm, while simpler upright forms and a firm horizontal band hold the lower half. Outlines are selective and softly hand-made, allowing blocks of color to define most edges. Light is even, with spatial depth supplied by overlap and scale rather than cast shadow. The overall effect is social, generous, and vividly patterned.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画具有现代平涂人物画表面，能看见笔触颗粒与不规则几何纹样。鲑粉、青绿、芥末黄、珊瑚和深绿组成相邻的大色域，按冷暖平衡安排，而非自然主义明暗。重复折角碎片聚成宽阔上方节奏，下半部由更简单的竖向形体和坚实横带稳住。轮廓有选择且带柔软手工痕，让色块本身确定大多数边缘。光线均匀，空间纵深靠重叠与尺度而非投影提供。整体效果有社交气息、宽厚且纹样鲜活。
theme_en: Five people conversing on benches beneath a patchwork tree
theme_zh: 五个人坐在拼布树下的长椅上交谈
name: Lubaina Himid
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
